description: On-device voice host: libelizainference (llama.cpp/ggml; Paradee-8M TTS with native misaki G2P and eSpeak NG out-of-lexicon fallback, Phonon-2 parakeet-tdt ASR with batch and streaming decode, Silero VAD) through the shared paradee-voice Java API (ai.eliza.voice) and RegisterNatives JNI. The only on-device speech engine; llama.cpp-based, no other neural runtime. These are the exact bytes scripts/android-stage-voice-models.mjs may stage; component evidence is recorded separately from installed-app, hardware audio and user acceptance.

bundle.install: APK assets copied to private storage with SHA-256 verification; Phonon b5x3t7 model is 208,932,352 bytes. No network installation.

asrSlot.current: Pinned Phonon-2/parakeet-tdt model; current native loader selects the in-tree ggml backend. Model architecture and backend registry override are separate.

evidence.scope: Component qualification of engine 6337fd4c4b (libelizainference sha256 49b01a18... arm64-v8a, 128b61f3... x86_64, as listed above) with the upstream qualify app (ai.eliza.voicequalify, AsrWerTest and ParadeeRoundTripTest) built from pin b25d8aef29 on 2026-11-07. Pixel 10a, arm64-v8a, Android API 37: ASR WER 1.94% over 101 LibriSpeech test-clean utterances (limit 6%, silence transcribed empty), ASR RTF 0.042; Paradee round trip WER 4.77% over 230 sentences (limit 8%), TTS RTF 0.055. x86_64 emulator (sdk_gphone64_x86_64, API 35, swiftshader): ASR WER 2.13% over 101 utterances (limit 6%, silence empty); round trip WER 4.90% over 230 sentences (limit 8%). Every transcript matches the b3eb2bf63b runs word for word on both ABIs. Component evidence only: not installed-app audio, live microphone, hardware playback or user acceptance. The historical qualification receipt binds the recorded qualify app and engine bytes to source b25d8aef2916385c571f4367e099809254fde0bb. The prior SDK b1817660a0347ae19551b9ee296410fe55f02d59 and explicit speech bridge patches have changed Java control flow and have not been requalified or accepted. The historical results do not qualify the current application, microphone capture, or hardware playback. A later historical component run at 4787d51a142c63c98371c832997184c53f7218d3 on November 7/8 passed on both ABIs with identical transcripts. Its receipt binds the installed qualify-app and JNI hashes and explicitly excludes LocalSpeechBridgePlugin, SpeechOutputWarmup, FirstWriteSpeechOutput, SpeechLeadTrim, live capture and the Alpha application. That historical rerun does not qualify SDK b1817660 application or its explicit speech bridge patches.

acceptance: Engine 6337fd4c4b passed component qualification on both ABIs (Pixel 10a arm64 and x86_64 API 35 emulator, 2026-11-07) with the qualify app built from b25d8aef29. On 2026-11-07 the owner accepted on-device speech on that evidence (P-82). That acceptance was recorded at pin 4e91de4cc7 with the statement that only the engine gitlink carried over from b25d8aef29; in fact the shared speech Java and the builder changed between b25d8aef29 and 4e91de4cc7, and changed again at 3a6d22670e. The changed code: ParadeeVoice (a per-request cancel path around every non-streaming native synthesis call, which the round-trip qualification calls), OnDeviceRecognizer (live recognizer session), ElizaInferencePlugin, LocalSpeechBridgePlugin (speech-output warm-up and its fenced close sites), the new SpeechLeadTrim, SpeechOutputWarmup and FirstWriteSpeechOutput, consumer.gradle, voice-product-inputs.mjs, build-native.ts (language selection) and the stream-contract StreamContract.java. The library bytes are unchanged and their component evidence stands, but the bridge under acceptance changed and was not requalified, so qualified is false until the owner re-accepts the changed bridge or it is requalified and accepted. This was never a measured spoken turn on versionCode 40, a same-day A/B, an AOSP image test or pilot acceptance. The prior source selection was SDK b1817660a0347ae19551b9ee296410fe55f02d59 with the explicit patches preserved in sourceAdmission.historicalPatchedSourceIntegration. Its changed bridge has not been accepted; qualified and userAccepted remain false. The historical 4787d51a14 component rerun is retained with its exact source and artifact bindings. On 2026-11-08 the owner accepted the historical 4787d51a14 requalification under P-83. That acceptance is bound to the older SDK and leaves qualification and acceptance of the prior SDK b1817660 and its explicit speech bridge patches pending. The merged SDK 5500c73b3d8ff8395999bbb620e7e3fc0ebb1df4 carries the shared speech source directly. Current admission retains the reviewed engine and model bytes and does not transfer any earlier device qualification or owner acceptance. The current SDK 6f414658b08cf8075d8fb12ece2ec968a221af7e includes the merged Alpha Compute namespace change and consumes the reviewed shared fixes directly from upstream, with zero product behavior patches. The renamed consumer package and generated embedding JNI class need new qualification; historical libraries, component receipts and owner acceptance do not qualify the renamed application.
